# Fundstash

> Fundstash is a 100% private, on-device personal finance and expense tracking application for iOS and Android. It operates with zero cloud infrastructure, zero user accounts, and no advertising, analytics or tracking SDKs of its own, saving all financial data locally in an AES-256 encrypted SQLite database. Your transactions and messages never leave your phone. The internet is used only if you choose to refresh exchange rates or download an AI model.

## Overview
Fundstash automates expense tracking directly on the user's smartphone without connecting to external banking aggregator APIs. It combines instant background SMS transaction parsing, local on-device machine learning (Apple Intelligence, Gemini Nano on Android AICore, or a downloadable SmolLM2 135M or Qwen3 0.6B GGUF model via llama.cpp), receipt OCR, conversational expense entry, dynamic budgeting, and deep spending analytics.

## Core Capabilities
- **Automated Bank SMS Sync**: Captures and parses transaction alert SMS messages in real-time on Android (native background listener) and iOS (Shortcuts automation). Extracts amounts, currencies, merchant names, payment modes, and account references.
- **On-Device AI & Decision Engine**: Evaluates transactions in smooth batches of 5 with throttle pacing. Categorizes spend, clarifies merchant descriptors, and powers a private on-device "Ask Fundstash" conversational assistant.
- **Offline Receipt & Invoice OCR**: Extracts line items, dates, and amounts from receipts locally using Apple Vision and Android MLKit without uploading photos to the cloud.
- **Natural Language Logging**: Rapid conversational text entry ("chai 40", "uber 250") and offline voice transcription.
- **Dynamic Budgets & Visual Health**: Color-coded budget tracking (<60% green, 60-80% amber, >80% red) with custom categories, emojis, and adaptive layouts across all screen sizes.
- **Visual Analytics**: Interactive spending breakdown donut chart with dynamic typography, Safe-to-Spend daily metrics, weekly trends, and end-of-month velocity forecasting.
- **Private Bill-Split Links**: Shares a bill split as a link (`fundstash.app/split#d=...`). The split rides in the part after `#`, which browsers never send to a server, and the recipient's browser reads it locally. The link is not encrypted, so anyone holding it can read the split.
- **IOU Reminders**: Shares a single debt the same way (`fundstash.app/iou#d=...`); the recipient can add it to their own ledger.
- **Multi-Account & Multi-Currency**: Manages bank accounts, credit cards, cash, and digital wallets across 107 currencies with offline ECB exchange rate tables.
- **Data Sovereignty**: Instant CSV/JSON exports and encrypted full database backups.

- [Support & FAQ](https://fundstash.app/support/): Detailed setup guide, bank SMS integration on iPhone and Android, troubleshooting, and Shortcuts automation notification controls.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fundstash.app/privacy/): Comprehensive zero-cloud, on-device architecture manifesto and data privacy guarantee.
- [Terms of Service](https://fundstash.app/terms/): Terms of service for personal use.
- [Beta](https://fundstash.app/beta/): How to join the pre-launch beta on iPhone (TestFlight) and Android (Google Play testing).
- [Bill Split Viewer](https://fundstash.app/split/): Shows a shared split in the browser, with a button to add it to the app.
- [IOU Viewer](https://fundstash.app/iou/): Shows a shared IOU reminder in the browser.
- [Contact](mailto:support@fundstash.app): Bug reports, questions and bank SMS formats the app does not read yet.
- [Full Technical & Feature Reference](https://fundstash.app/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive deep-dive documentation for AI models and autonomous agents.
